title: Bit Depth Quantizer
description: The learner will calculate the number of levels available at a given bit depth, and the smallest bit depth that provides a required number of levels, for 5 challenge questions, with all 5 correct within two attempts each.
creator: Open Study Buddy
author: Dan McCreary

educational.learningObjective: The learner will calculate the number of levels available at a given bit depth, and the smallest bit depth that provides a required number of levels, for 5 challenge questions, with all 5 correct within two attempts each.

controls: Bit depth slider: 1 to 16 bits, default 4
Start challenges / Next question / Show score button
pedagogical.model: levels = 2^n evenly spaced from -1 to +1 with spacing 2/(levels-1); each point of one sine cycle is rounded to the nearest level, halfway rounds up.
